versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "行业新闻聚合与热度排序工具" (Industry News Collector)
- Implements a multi-dimensional, layered search strategy with strict industry boundary definitions
- Collects, verifies, and ranks industry news by popularity, with negative keyword and source validation
- Supports classification and exclusion of related but non-core industry events
- Outputs clean Chinese news summaries, ranked by heat, including source links and coverage stats
